# pnpm.packages_with_script lists the packages that define a script, to drive
# one pnpm.run slice per package; a change reruns only its package's slice.
# The workspace root's own script tracks every package.
[!exec:pnpm] skip

bit
stdout 'build\["alpha"\] ✔ ok'
stdout 'build\["beta"\] ✔ ok'
! stdout 'gamma'
stdout 'names │ alpha beta$'
stdout 'everything ▶ pnpm run build-all$'
stdout 'everything ✔ ok'
grep '\Aalpha\n\z' packages/alpha/out.txt
grep '\Abeta\n\z' packages/beta/out.txt
exists out/all.txt

bit
! stdout '✔ ok'

cp alpha.changed.js packages/alpha/name.js
bit
stdout 'build\["alpha"\] ✔ ok'
! stdout 'build\["beta"\] ✔'
stdout 'everything ✔ ok'
grep '\Aalpha 2\n\z' packages/alpha/out.txt

cp gamma.changed.js packages/gamma/index.js
bit
! stdout 'build\[.* ✔'
stdout 'everything ✔ ok'

-- BUILD.bit --
let pkg = pnpm.packages_with_script("build")
let built = pnpm.packages_with_script("build")

deps = pnpm.install {}

build[pkg] = pnpm.run {
  script     = "build"
  package    = pkg
  outputs    = "packages/#{pkg}/out.txt"
  depends_on = [deps]
}

names = exec {
  command = "echo #{shell_join(built)}"
  inputs  = []
}

everything = pnpm.run {
  script     = "build-all"
  outputs    = "out"
  depends_on = [deps, build]
}
-- pnpm-lock.yaml --
lockfileVersion: '9.0'

settings:
  autoInstallPeers: true
  excludeLinksFromLockfile: false

importers:

  .: {}

  packages/alpha: {}

  packages/beta: {}

  packages/gamma: {}
-- pnpm-workspace.yaml --
packages:
  - "packages/*"
-- package.json --
{ "name": "root", "private": true, "scripts": { "build-all": "mkdir -p out && echo all > out/all.txt" } }
-- packages/alpha/package.json --
{ "name": "alpha", "version": "1.0.0", "scripts": { "build": "node -p 'require(\"./name\")' > out.txt" } }
-- packages/alpha/name.js --
module.exports = "alpha";
-- alpha.changed.js --
module.exports = "alpha 2";
-- packages/beta/package.json --
{ "name": "beta", "version": "1.0.0", "scripts": { "build": "node -p 'require(\"./name\")' > out.txt" } }
-- packages/beta/name.js --
module.exports = "beta";
-- packages/gamma/package.json --
{ "name": "gamma", "version": "1.0.0", "scripts": { "lint": "true" } }
-- packages/gamma/index.js --
module.exports = "gamma";
-- gamma.changed.js --
module.exports = "gamma 2";
